channel.title: Central Bank of Bitcoin: Statements and Releases
channel.description: Every announcement the Central Bank of Bitcoin has made about itself.

item.title: CBOB 2026-7: The founding charters will be issued
item.description:
Correction entered 11 October 2026: Deposits precede participation. Read the dated correction above the original release.
Original statement: The Bank did not print today.
Construction of the vaults is nearly complete. When they open, the Bank will issue two hundred forty founding charters, one for each Proof of Burn, at no cost.
The window is seven days. Not eight. It does not reopen.
Construction of the vaults is nearly complete.
When the vaults open, the Bank will issue its founding charters. There are two hundred forty of them, one for each Proof of Burn in existence, and they are issued at no cost.
A founding charter is claimed by presenting a Proof of Burn. The Proof of Burn is destroyed on presentation, and the charter is issued in its place. One Proof of Burn, one charter. The network fee for the transaction is paid by the holder.
The claim window is seven days. Its opening and its close are fixed before it opens, and the date will be announced before the window opens. Once fixed, the window is not moved, extended, paused or reopened. Not on request. Not by the Governors. Not by this office.
A Proof of Burn not presented by the close is forfeited. Its charter is never issued. The Proof of Burn remains with its holder as a record of the burn, and it is not redeemable for anything further.
No charter after these will be issued at no cost. Every later charter is paid for.
The holders of the founding charters will form the governance of the Bank: the voting body, the council, and the Governors.
An unactivated charter contains nothing and receives nothing. Activation is a separate matter and will be addressed separately.

item.title: CBOB 2026-6: The terms of issuance are settled
item.description:
The Bank did not print today.
The terms on which the unit is issued are settled. Two thousand one hundred charters. One million units behind each. Two billion one hundred million in total, and that is the whole of the issue.
A charter does not receive the unit. A charter releases it.
Two thousand one hundred charters will ever be granted by this Bank. One million units stand behind each of them. The total is 2,100,000,000. That is the whole of the issue and there is no further issue contemplated.
A charter does not receive the unit. A charter releases it. When a vault is chartered, the million units standing behind it enter the market on a schedule, and the Bank offers them. No holder of a charter is given units, and none are given to anyone else.
The Bank is the only issuer. An earlier release recorded that the unit is obtained from the Bank and from nowhere else. That was the position when no market for it existed. The Bank issues, and only the Bank issues; what changes hands after that changes hands as any instrument does, and the Bank takes no position on it.
What is paid for the unit is converted to bitcoin. 85 percent of that is placed in member vaults and 15 percent is retained, as all revenue is divided and as Section VI of Purposes and Functions provides. The division does not change and has never changed.
Stated policy is unchanged. The Bank intends a target of zero for $CBOB. The unit is not a reserve and was never offered as one. It is a unit of activity inside this Bank, and it is spent. A holder who spends it has used it for its purpose.
The reserve is bitcoin. The reserve does not move.

item.title: CBOB 2026-5: The schedule of vaults is complete
item.description:
Correction entered 11 October 2026: levels are permanent; boosts temporarily change payout weight. See the dated correction above the original release.
Original statement: The Bank did not print today.
The schedule of vaults is complete. There are five. Your vault is assigned at activation, by fate, and may be raised.
Upgrades are settled in $CBOB. It is obtained from the Bank and from nowhere else.
The Schedule of Vaults, First Edition, is published in full and is to be read with Purposes and Functions.
There are five levels of member bank vault. Level One is the smallest and Level Five is the largest. A vault's level is assigned at activation, by fate. It cannot be applied for and it cannot be appealed. It may be raised, one step at a time, and it never falls.
Every level carries a weight, and weight is the only quantity that decides how a distribution is divided. A Level Five vault receives three times what a Level One vault receives from the same distribution. Not sixteen. The Bank is not a casino. The Bank is a bank.
The eighty five percent described in Section VI of Purposes and Functions is divided among activated vaults by weight. An unactivated vault carries a weight of zero, sits outside the denominator, and receives nothing. At every settlement the Bank publishes the count at each level and the sum of their weights, so that any member may do the division and arrive at the figure the Bank arrived at.
A level is raised by burning $CBOB. It is raised one step at a time and no step may be skipped. A raised level is permanent, and a level never falls. $CBOB is obtained from the Bank and is obtained nowhere else.
The Schedule states four matters the Bank has not settled, in a section of its own, so that the reader is not required to guess and is not invited to assume.

item.title: CBOB 2026-4: Vault equipment tested. Both results entered as successes.
item.description:
The Bank tested the vaults this morning.
Staff put money in. Nothing came out.
Staff then tried to take money out of a vault the Bank does not own, and were refused by the Bank's own equipment.
Both results are entered into the record as successes.
The vaults are coming.
The Bank sets out the test in full.
In the first test staff deposited value into a vault and then attempted to retrieve it. The value went in. Nothing came out. The vault behaved exactly as Section VIII of Purposes and Functions describes: it accepted the deposit and offered no mechanism by which the deposit could be taken back out. The Bank did not treat this as a fault at any point during the test.
In the second test staff attempted to take value out of a vault belonging to somebody else. The equipment refused. The Bank notes, for the record, that the equipment refused the Bank.
A reader who finds the first result alarming and the second reassuring has understood the design. They are one property, tested from two sides. The equipment that will not let a member out is the equipment that will not let anybody in, and the Bank declined to build one without the other.
The Bank passes no comment on institutions whose equipment refuses only the second of these.

item.title: CBOB 2026-3: Purposes and Functions, First Edition, is published
item.description:
Correction entered 11 October 2026: Crediting and delivery are separate entries. Read the dated correction above the original release.
Original statement: The Bank has been asked to explain itself.
Purposes and Functions. First Edition. Thirteen sections on the member bank system, the impossibility of withdrawal, and related matters.
It contains no surprises. If you find one, you have misread something.
The document is the Bank's founding instrument. It is published in full, at once, and without a summary.
Section VI divides every revenue event eighty five percent to activated vaults and fifteen percent to the Bank, permanently, and the eighty five arrives without a claim process. Section VII states the Bank's monetary policy for its internal unit, in bold, and the reader is advised that it is not the policy the reader is expecting. Section VIII describes the vault, which accepts deposits and does not process withdrawals. Section IX describes bank failure, under which a member destroys the vault and receives one hundred percent of its contents immediately, with no penalty and no committee.
The Bank publishes its most unusual mechanics ahead of its most flattering ones. That is the practice and it is not under review.
There is no executive summary. A reader who wishes to know what the Bank does is invited to read what the Bank wrote.

item.title: CBOB 2026-2: Issuance closed. The founding charters are entered.
item.description:
The Bank did not print today.
371 of 1,030 destroyed. 659 remain. 240 Proof of Burn issued to 41 members.
The vaults are coming. A Proof of Burn charters one. There is no other instrument.
Issuance is closed. The Bank enters the result and does not expect to enter it again.
Three hundred and seventy one MAGA Giraffes were destroyed. Six hundred and fifty nine remain and will not be destroyed under this instrument, the instrument having closed. Two hundred and forty Proof of Burn were issued, to forty one members.
Those two hundred and forty are the founding charters. They were issued by fire, at no cost beyond the Giraffe, and no further charter will be issued on those terms. The permanent ceiling of the member bank system is two thousand one hundred charters, ever. The Governors decide when, and whether, any of the remainder is made available.
A charter is not a vault. A charter becomes a vault at activation, and activation is described in Purposes and Functions. Until then it carries a weight of zero and receives nothing.
The Bank thanks nobody, congratulates nobody, and files the result.

item.title: CBOB 2026-1: Issuance of Proof of Burn to close 17 August
item.description:
The Bank did not print today.
Of 1,030 MAGA Giraffes struck, 343 have been destroyed. 687 remain.
The vaults are coming. A Proof of Burn charters one. There is no other instrument, and there will be no other instrument.
Issuance ends Monday 17 August, 07:00 Austin. Credits held at that time expire. They do not carry. They do not transfer.
The Bank sets out the terms in full, so that no member is required to infer them.
A Proof of Burn is obtained by destroying a MAGA Giraffe. The Giraffe is destroyed on chain. Nothing is held against its recovery, nothing is sent back, and the Bank does not operate a reversal. The Bank mentions this not because it is unclear but because it is final.
The instrument is the charter. A Proof of Burn is the only route to a member bank vault. The Bank has not built a second route and does not intend to build one. A member holding no Proof of Burn at the close will hold none after it.
Issuance closes at seven o'clock and three seconds in the morning, Austin time, on Monday the seventeenth of August. The Bank is aware that the three seconds serve no purpose. They are in the contract. The Bank does not amend a contract for tidiness.
The Bank will publish the census at the close and will not extend the window.
